issuer: the vehicle administration office (车辆管理所) of the public security traffic administration

licence.name: 机动车驾驶证 (小型汽车, C1)

note: Read 2026-10-30. The Ministry of Public Security's Regulations on the Application for and Use of Motor Vehicle Driving Licences (公安部令第162号, in force from 1 April 2022, gov.cn's text) give a small car licence from 18 (Art. 14), and terms of six years, ten years and long-term (Art. 13), a driver who doesn't reach 12 points in any scoring cycle of the six-year licence being given a ten-year one (Art. 62); so a first licence is kept as 6 years. The NDRC and Ministry of Finance notice 发改价格〔2004〕2831号 (on ndrc.gov.cn) sets the licence's production fee (工本费) at 10 yuan a licence, the fee held; the driving test fees are set by each province and aren't held, nor is the driving school. The 12-month probation (实习期) isn't held. The resident identity card is the ids engine's.

sources.title: 机动车驾驶证申领和使用规定 (公安部令第162号), 中国政府网
sources.said: 第十三条 机动车驾驶证有效期分为六年、十年和长期。 ... 申请小型汽车、小型自动挡汽车、残疾人专用小型自动挡载客汽车、轻便摩托车准驾车型的，在18周岁以上； ... 机动车驾驶人在机动车驾驶证的六年有效期内，每个记分周期均未记满12分的，换发十年有效期的机动车驾驶证

sources.title: 国家发展改革委 财政部 关于加强和规范机动车牌证工本费等收费标准管理有关问题的通知 (发改价格[2004]2831号)
sources.said: 在对考试合格的机动车驾驶证申请人发放驾驶证时，收取驾驶证工本费的收费标准为每证10元。
